title: Very like a whale.
html_source: A reference to Hamlet, act 3 scene 2, where Prince Hamlet and Polonius are considering the shape of a cloud. Initially, Prince Hamlet notes it to resemble a camel, then a weasel, then a whale, all of which Polonius fervently affirmed. These, of course, look nothing alike in any manner, all of which to mock Polonius.
